title: Phir Chand Moharram
body:
phir chand moharram ka namudar hua hai
phir chaak dil e ahmade mukhtar hua hai
<<DIVIDER>>
is chand mein qasim ke kate daste hinaai
sar nanga dulhan ka sare bazaar hua hai
phir chand moharram ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
is chand mein baazu kate abbase jari ke
thanda alam e ahmade mukhtaar hua hai
phir chand moharram ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
is chand mein akbar ke lagi seene pe barchi
asghar hadaf e teere sitamgaar hua hai
phir chand moharram ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
is chand ki dasvi ko behan bhai se chooti
pamaal tan e sayyade abraar hua hai
phir chand moharram ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
is chand mein abid ke pada tauq galay mein
aur qaid bhi wo saahibe aazaar hua hai
phir chand moharram ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
khusnoodi e zehra ka wo haamil hua akhtar
jo sibte payambar ka azadar hua hai
phir chand moharram ka...
author: Akhtar Zaidi
